svg.title: Nonlocal PINO architecture and physics-only training
svg.desc: Background rolling geometry/operator inputs and core-halo sampling; alternative patch or two-stream point encoders; separate weighted spatial reads; three subsequent decoder layers each with time FiLM; nonlocal spatial residuals, time JVP and case-dependent loss control and optimization. Textures are schematic.
